Name: Stardew Stabilizer For Android - Reduces crashes and slowdowns in long sessions
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
This is a ported version for Android users of another mod : Stardew Stabilizer. 

Primary benefit is: Keeps long modded sessions running smoother by preventing the gradual slowdown that can build up over time. It does cleanups when memory stays high, which helps reduce lag spikes and lowers the chance of crashes after hours of play.



See the mod page for more details: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40484]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40484



[/url]This is a separate branch for android related issue discussion SMAPI error log.  I dont play on Android, this is an attempt to bring that over.

Code at: https://github.com/ZeroXPatch/Projects-for-Nexus-Mod/tree/main/Stardew%20Stabilizer%20For%20Andriod
